title: The Thirteen Virtues (excerpt)
author: Benjamin Franklin
rights: 美国：1791 年出版；中国：作者1790 年去世，保护期已满
intro: 本杰明·富兰克林（1706–1790）是美国开国元勋之一，同时也是政治家、科学家和印刷商。《富兰克林自传》未能写完，1791 年首次以法文译本出版。这一段讲他为自己订立的十三条德行，决定一次只专注一条，逐周修炼，并用小册子逐日记录过失。
tips: 长句多，按分号和逗号分意群，“first”“one at a time”等词稍加重读。
旧式拼写 judg'd、arrang'd 读作 judged、arranged，& 读作 and。

segments.text: My Intention being to acquire the Habitude of all these Virtues, I judg'd it would be well not to distract my Attention by attempting the whole at once, but to fix it on one of them at a time,
and when I should be Master of that, then to proceed to another, and so on till I should have gone thro' the thirteen.
And as the previous Acquisition of some might facilitate the Acquisition of certain others, I arrang'd them with that View as they stand above.

Temperance first, as it tends to procure that Coolness & Clearness of Head, which is so necessary where constant Vigilance was to be kept up, and Guard maintained, against the unremitting Attraction of ancient Habits,
and the Force of perpetual Temptations. This being acquir'd & establish'd, Silence would be more easy, and my Desire being to gain Knowledge at the same time that I improv'd in Virtue,
and considering that in Conversation it was obtain'd rather by the use of the Ears than of the Tongue, & therefore wishing to break a Habit I was getting into of Prattling, Punning & Joking,
which only made me acceptable to trifling Company, I gave Silence the second Place.
